walkthroughs.body_html:
Organisation of the Organism — a core area of GCSE Biology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Organisation of the Organism brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Organisation of the Organism.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: The correct order of organisation from smallest to largest is:
options: cell, tissue, organ, organ system
organ, tissue, cell, organ system
tissue, cell, organ system, organ
organ system, organ, tissue, cell

mcqs.q: A group of similar cells working together is a(n):
options: tissue
organ
organism
organelle

mcqs.q: A root hair cell is specialised for absorption because it has:
options: a long extension giving a large surface area
many chloroplasts for photosynthesis
a thick waxy outer wall
no cell membrane

mcqs.q: If a cell's image is 50 mm and its actual size is 0.05 mm, the magnification is:
Which is larger and more complex, a tissue or an organ?
options: An organ is larger and more complex; it is made of several different tissues working together.
Tissues and organs are exactly the same thing.
A tissue is larger and more complex than an organ.
A tissue is made of just one single cell.

mcqs.q: Are all the cells in a tissue identical types?
options: A tissue is made of just one single cell.
A tissue contains every different type of cell in the body.
Tissues and organs are exactly the same thing.
A tissue is a group of similar, specialised cells working together for one function, such as muscle tissue.
Magnification equals actual size divided by image size.
Magnification equals image size divided by actual size, with both measurements in the same units.
Tissues and organs are exactly the same thing.
Magnification is the same thing as the microscope's resolution.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Magnification”?
options: A group of similar cells that work together to perform a particular function, such as muscle tissue or xylem tissue.
How many times larger an image is than the real object, calculated as image size divided by actual size.
The basic structural and functional unit of a living organism; the smallest unit that can carry out the processes of life.
A structure made of several different tissues working together to carry out a particular function, such as the stomach or a leaf.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Cell”?
options: A group of similar cells that work together to perform a particular function, such as muscle tissue or xylem tissue.
A cell adapted in structure to carry out a specific job efficiently, such as a red blood cell, root hair cell or sperm cell.
The basic structural and functional unit of a living organism; the smallest unit that can carry out the processes of life.
A structure made of several different tissues working together to carry out a particular function, such as the stomach or a leaf.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Organ”?
options: A structure made of several different tissues working together to carry out a particular function, such as the stomach or a leaf.
A group of similar cells that work together to perform a particular function, such as muscle tissue or xylem tissue.
A group of organs that work together to perform a major function, such as the digestive system or the circulatory system.
A cell adapted in structure to carry out a specific job efficiently, such as a red blood cell, root hair cell or sperm cell.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Specialised cell”?
options: A cell adapted in structure to carry out a specific job efficiently, such as a red blood cell, root hair cell or sperm cell.
How many times larger an image is than the real object, calculated as image size divided by actual size.
A group of similar cells that work together to perform a particular function, such as muscle tissue or xylem tissue.
The basic structural and functional unit of a living organism; the smallest unit that can carry out the processes of life.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Organ system”?
options: A group of organs that work together to perform a major function, such as the digestive system or the circulatory system.
A group of similar cells that work together to perform a particular function, such as muscle tissue or xylem tissue.
How many times larger an image is than the real object, calculated as image size divided by actual size.
The basic structural and functional unit of a living organism; the smallest unit that can carry out the processes of life.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Tissue”?
options: A structure made of several different tissues working together to carry out a particular function, such as the stomach or a leaf.
A group of organs that work together to perform a major function, such as the digestive system or the circulatory system.
A group of similar cells that work together to perform a particular function, such as muscle tissue or xylem tissue.
How many times larger an image is than the real object, calculated as image size divided by actual size.

mcqs.q: An image of a cell is 50 mm wide and the real cell is 0.05 mm wide. Calculate the magnification.
options: 100 times
500 times
10 times
1000 times

sequence.def: Smallest unit of life; basic building block of all organisms
Group of similar cells working together, e.g. muscle tissue
Several tissues combined for a function, e.g. the heart
Group of organs working together, e.g. circulatory system
Complete living individual built from all organ systems
